top_signals.title: CVR Energy Nears $4 Billion Refinery Deal With Marathon
top_signals.summary: Marathon Petroleum is nearing a deal for the sale of several refineries to CVR Energy, with the sale expected to be worth $4 billion, the Wall Street Journal has reported, citing unnamed sources. The deal could be announced later today. The refining sector has become the star of the oil industry this year as the wars in the Persian Gulf and Russia-Ukraine have severely crippled global fuel supply, prompting refiners outside the war zones to boost their output. The market situation has driven a surge in refining margins to all-time highs, making…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Cinven Set to Back Theramex Acquisition With €1.5 Billion Debt
top_signals.summary: Cinven is tapping banks to help finance its acquisition of specialty pharmaceutical company Theramex with debt financing of around €1.5 billion ($1.7 billion).

top_signals.title: Michigan State cyber incident claimed by ransomware gang behind recent hospital attack
top_signals.summary: A recent post by the BYOD gang appears to line up with a security incident that prompted campus-wide action at Michigan State University. BYOD drew attention in October for an attack on the University of New Mexico.
